paper_statement: Mixed anchor rows and columns are constructed as bipartite cliques spanning multiple treatment levels while preserving the target row's same-treatment data, relying on shared latent row factors.
scope: K=1; target treatment probability 0.01; ten 300x100 rank-3 MCAR matrices; relative Gaussian noise 0.001; 40 deterministic targets per seed
required_checks: Every selected Algorithm 3 edge satisfies D_ab=D_ib!=0 and D_aj=d.
At least one selected clique contains more than one treatment level.
The Algorithm 2 estimator is evaluated with paper-scale noisy data.
A paired violation of Assumption 2.5 increases scaled MAE by more than 5x.
A one-edge corruption and an incidence mutation are rejected.
An independently implemented checker regenerates all ten seeds and matches the frozen result.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED iff every required check passes; otherwise the verifier exits nonzero.
